name: Zhongjianornis
sum: Toothless, beaked, pigeon-sized bird from the Jiufotang Formation at Jianchang, Liaoning.
holotype: The only fossil, from Jianchang (number in Zhou et al. 2010).
author: Zhou et al. 2010

sources.text: Zhou, Z.; Zhang, F.; Li, Z. 2010. A new Lower Cretaceous bird from China and tooth reduction in early avian evolution. Proceedings of the Royal Society B 277(1679): 219–227. doi:10.1098/rspb.2009.0885
